name: Google Play Games Services branding guidelines
content:
Google's Play Games Services branding elements may be used in an app without pre-approval, provided Google's Play Games Services branding guidelines are followed: https://developer.android.com/games/pgs/branding

Use of Google brands in ways not expressly covered by those guidelines is not allowed without prior written consent from Google. See also the Guidelines for Third Party Use of Google Brand Features: https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines
